description: The signed-in couple's own guest list on Zola: add up to 25 households. 1 household gets 1 invitation: up to 2 adults (a guest and a partner, or a plus-one with no name yet) and their children. Each new guest is invited to the events on the wedding website, or to the event_ids from zola_list_my_wedding_events, with no answer. A call without confirm_token changes nothing: it returns a preview with a confirm_token. Zola checks the list for a guest with the same name or email first: a match stops the call (status possible_duplicate) until the couple says that the match is another person. Show the preview to the couple. Call again with the same guest_groups and the confirm_token only after the couple says yes. No tool removes a guest. Zola sends no message to the guest. Requires Zola sign-in (account:write).

confirm_token.description: The confirm_token of the preview. Give it only after the couple said yes to that preview, with the same guest_groups

guest_groups.description: 1 entry for each new household, at most 25

address1.description: The street number and name only, for example 250 Greenwich St. Put an apartment, suite, unit or floor in address2

address2.description: The apartment, suite, unit or floor, for example Apt 4B or Fl 39. Leave it out when the address has none

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, for example US. With an address and no country: US

event_ids.description: Event IDs from zola_list_my_wedding_events. Leave it out for the events on the wedding website

guests.description: The guests of 1 invitation, the main guest first

first_name.description: Leave it out only for a plus-one with no name yet

last_name.description: The first adult needs it. A child or a partner with no last name gets the last name of the first adult

plus_one.description: True for a plus-one with no name yet: give no name

ignore_match_ids.description: The guest_id of each match of a zola_add_my_guest possible_duplicate preview that the couple says is another person

other_person_guest_ids.description: The old name of ignore_match_ids. Give ignore_match_ids

name: zola_add_my_guest

outputSchema.description: The preview or the result of new guest groups on the guest list of the signed-in couple

cannot_undo.description: What the change removes and Zola cannot restore

changed.description: True only when this call changed the guest list

confirm_token.description: Give it to zola_add_my_guest with the same guest_groups, only after the couple says yes

expires_at.description: The end of the validity of confirm_token, ISO 8601 UTC

links.description: The zola.com pages for this data

records.description: The new guest groups, in the order of the call

event_id.description: For event: the event_id of zola_list_my_wedding_events

field.description: guest: a new guest. plus_one: a guest with no name yet. event: an event of the invitation. The other fields are the contact of the group

hidden.description: True for an address, email, or phone: the value is not given

to.description: The name of the guest or of the event. Null for a contact field

guest_group_id.description: The id of the new guest group, after the add. Null in a preview

matches.description: The guests on the list with the same name or email as a new guest

guest_id.description: The guest on the list. If it is another person, give it in ignore_match_ids of zola_add_my_guest

new_guest.description: The new guest of the call

name.description: The guests of the new group

replayed.description: True when this is the stored result of an earlier call with the same confirm_token

status.description: preview: nothing changed, confirm_token adds the guests. possible_duplicate: nothing changed, a new guest matches a guest on the list, no confirm_token. done: added. draft_changed: nothing changed, a new preview

title: Add My Guests
